dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Are you kidding me? Isn't it obvious?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Well, I dunno how you haven't noticed, but I totally love it here! I mean, you built this whole place from the ground up! How cool is that!?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: To get specific though, here's three reasons why I dig this place: It's fun, chill, and I can sleep with both eyes closed!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, in a word, it's dope?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Hahaha! You got that from me, didn't you?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Anyway, look — I wanna level with you. In my mind, there's a fine line between graciously accepting the hospitality of your host and being a leech.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Now, I know you won't let me pay any rent while I'm here, 'cause we're friends and all, but I will at least insist on making myself useful. So, if you catch me cleaning or gardening at any point — don't try and stop me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I couldn't possibly make a guest do my chores...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Knew you'd say that. But if all I am is a guest, does that mean you want me to treat this like a hotel?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Or would you rather I made myself at home?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Okay, so do you have any objection to me cleaning up after myself while I'm in my own home?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: I'll give you to the count of three to raise any objections — ready? Three! Okay, great, no objections! Glad that's settled.
